name: Air Fryer Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Quick, small-batch cookies with a crispy edge and soft center.
recipe: Add half a cup of unsalted butter (ideally) to a mixing bowl
Add 1/4 cup granulated Sugar
Add 1/4 cup brown sugar
Mix using a mixer thoroughly until cloudy
Add a dash of vanilla extract
1 1/2 Cup of all purpose flour
1/4 Tbsp baking soda
1/4 Tbsp Salt
Mix again thoroughly
Add choco chips/walnuts/raisins (optional)
Take out small balls of dough and place on parchment paper on air fryer
Preheat if needed, heat for around 15 mins at 150'C
Let them cool for 5 mins and harden
Enjoy!

name: Aloo Beans Sabzi
description: A classic North Indian dry stir-fry of potatoes and green beans.
recipe: Heat oil in a pan and temper with cumin seeds.
Add potatoes and sauté for 5 minutes until slightly browned.
Add green beans and spices; mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat until vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Savory stir-fried rice with seasoned chicken and vegetables.
recipe: Sauté chicken in a wok until cooked through; set aside.
Scramble eggs in the same pan, then add vegetables.
Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce.
Stir-fry on high heat for 3-5 minutes until well combined.

name: Vegetable Frittata
description: An Italian-style open-faced omelet baked to perfection.
recipe: Whisk eggs and milk in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Sauté onions and spinach in an oven-safe skillet.
Pour egg mixture over the vegetables and sprinkle with feta.
Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes until the center is set.

name: Classic Marinara Sauce
description: A versatile and robust tomato sauce for pasta or pizza.
recipe: Sauté garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes and oregano; season with salt.
Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes to develop flavor.
Stir in fresh basil before serving.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Indian cottage cheese cubes in a smooth, creamy spinach gravy.
recipe: Blanch spinach and blend into a smooth puree.
Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste until golden.
Add puree and spices, simmering for 10 minutes.
Gently stir in paneer cubes and cream before serving.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Light and airy breakfast staples perfect for toppings.
recipe: Whisk dry ingredients and wet ingredients in separate bowls.
Combine until just mixed (lumps are fine).
Pour batter onto a hot greased griddle.
Flip when bubbles form on the surface and cook until golden.

name: Kanda Poha
description: A popular Maharashtrian breakfast made with flattened rice.
recipe: Rinse poha in a colander and drain; set aside.
Heat oil and fry peanuts, then add mustard seeds and onions.
Add turmeric, salt, and poha; toss gently to combine.
Garnish with lemon juice and fresh coriander.

name: Sirke Vala Pyaaz
recipe: Peel onions and make a small cross-cut on top.
Mix vinegar, water, salt, and beetroot in a glass jar.
Submerge the onions in the liquid.
Let sit for 24 hours at room temperature for the best color and flavor.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
description: Warm, comforting soup made from fresh roasted tomatoes.
recipe: Roast tomatoes, onion, and garlic at 200°C for 30 minutes.
Blend the roasted vegetables until smooth.
Transfer to a pot, add broth, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain if desired and finish with a swirl of cream.
